## Parent

turnkey-vnm

## What to build

Cached solidity tests fuzz with a fixed seed derived from the target label, so the same inputs always run the same fuzz cases. Stochastic fuzzing needs the `no-test-cache` label (hazard S4, spec §4).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Two runs of the same fuzz test use the same seed
- [ ] Different targets get different seeds

## Blocked by

None — can start immediately.
title: Solidity fuzzing is seeded from the target label
